assembly_summary: Early surf strikes the fixed building, collapses, and settles into a low wash. Seven original hurricane-doodle strokes form the water abstraction; the archive shows storm surge, not a visible rotating cyclone.
review_note: Three blind reviews completed: original doodle identity and building composition hold. Remaining gap: continuing foreground surge changes too little in later keys. Raster trace recall 0.9514 fails the 0.98 bar. SAM switches target; classifier and normal-speed playback approval remain unrun. No training ran.
remaining_gap: Continuing foreground surge is underrepresented in the later keys.
